2607.14561.title: MARS: Multi-hop Adaptive Retrieval and SPARQL Generation for KGQA
2607.14561.paper_summary: Large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated strong reasoning performance, but their tendency to hallucinate limits their reliability in knowledge-intensive tasks requiring up-to-date and grounded information. Combining knowledge graphs (KGs) with LLMs facilitates the use of explicit symbolic knowledge that can be continuously updated without costly fine-tuning, while benefiting from rapidly advancing LLM reasoning. We propose MARS, a scalable knowledge graph question answering (KGQA) approach that requires no model fine-tuning. Rather than relying on open-ended agentic exploration, MARS performs a structured retrieval procedure that links question entities to the KG and iteratively retrieves relevant next-hop information. At each step, MARS decides whether to continue graph traversal or to generate the final SPARQL query, allowing the model to adapt the retrieval depth to the question while keeping the overall pipeline more predictable than fully agentic approaches. We evaluate MARS on three established KGQA benchmarks across several LLMs and settings, including multilingual evaluation, and provide insights through ablation studies and error analysis. Our approach achieves competitive performance relative to state-of-the-art methods while remaining efficient and scalable. The evaluation results, code and resources are publicly available: https://github.com/dice-group/mars-kgqa.
2607.14561.paper_summary_zh: 大型語言模型（LLMs）展現了強大的推理能力，但它們的幻覺傾向限制了它們在需要最新和基礎信息的知識密集型任務中的可靠性。將知識圖（KGs）與LLMs結合，可以利用明確的符號知識，這些知識可以不需要昂貴的微調而持續更新，同時受益於迅速進步的LLM推理。我們提出了MARS，一種可擴展的知識圖問題回答（KGQA）方法，無需模型微調。MARS不依賴於開放式的自主探索，而是執行結構化的檢索程序，將問題實體連結到KG並迭代檢索相關的下一步信息。在每一步中，MARS決定是繼續圖形遍歷還是生成最終的SPARQL查詢，這使得模型能夠根據問題調整檢索深度，同時使整體流程比完全自主的方法更可預測。我們在三個已建立的KGQA基準上評估MARS，涵蓋多個LLMs和設置，包括多語言評估，並通過消融研究和錯誤分析提供見解。我們的方法在相對於最先進的方法中達到了具有競爭力的性能，同時保持高效和可擴展性。評估結果、代碼和資源均可公開獲得：https://github.com/dice-group/mars-kgqa。
